template: Bounded blind analogue ranking, one response only. Rank the eight anonymized candidate prefixes by structural similarity to the query. Read ONLY this exact packet: {packet} . Write ONLY one JSON response exclusively (no overwrite) to {response} . No browsing, other files, repository, outcomes, agents or models. All data are observed prefixes; future C/D and historical candidate outcomes are deliberately absent. Signed normalized log prices preserve direction. H1/H4 arrays are oldest first [relative close hours, open, high, low, close, relative volume]; volume is log1p(volume) minus own preceding20 mean log1p(volume). Phase arrays use own last known H1 close and sigma72. D1 includes the then-confirmed A/B, observed A→B→P path and physical elapsed durations; missing context is explicit and provisional structure is not a completed future wave. Compare structure, scale, duration and context using the numeric packet. Do not infer calendar identity. Return ONLY JSON with exactly {"query_id":string,"ranked_candidate_ids":[8 unique allowed IDs, most similar first],"no_match":boolean,"evidence":string}. Even if no_match=true return all eight IDs. Evidence <=1500 characters, cite concrete relative coordinates/segments, no forecasts/probabilities/TP/SL. One response only; do not retry or create alternatives. Read every candidate; use complete bounded/chunked reads or arithmetic summaries over all arrays, never silently truncated output. After writing output return same JSON.
provenance: Coordinator capture of actual identical spawn message template used from debug01 onward; only exact packet and response paths vary. Source prompt.json is frozen semantic contract; dispatch transport fixed before calls. This literal wrapper capture is recorded during execution, not falsely pre-dated. No prompt revision, outcomes or quality used.
